items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lionel had married Gladys... In 1933 he was married to Gladys.

ctx.x: That‟s right, and that was very important.
Yeah. From there we went to California, my first trip to California. Now Lionel Hampton and I had gone to school together and Lionel had married Gladys and moved to California.

items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
